sr_entity_resolve.title: Resolve Standup Republic entities
sr_entity_resolve.description: Resolve an ambiguous human name, natural-language identifier, or supported provider identifier into stable SR references. For a dated performance, resolve an event; use show for its reusable template. Supply the narrowest plausible entity_types plus optional city/date/provider hints; full date_hint values are RFC3339. Product resolution is connected for event, location, profile, and show; internal Coordination resolution is connected for artifact, active plugin_user, message, project, task, and legacy attachment records. Other requested-only types return resolver_entity_type_not_connected with connected_entity_types. Use sr_entity_get when a canonical ref is already known; slot is a bookable lineup time window and is normally queried with available_slots_v1. Read-only; do not probe unsupported types.

sr_entity_get.title: Get one Standup Republic entity
sr_entity_get.description: Read answer-ready sections of exactly one stable SR entity reference. Choose sections from the entity-type registry; source_mode defaults to canonical, compare is for bounded canonical/provider comparison, and provider_live is Admin-only where connected. subject_ref/resource_ref add an already-resolved relationship context and never replace entity_ref. The result reports source, freshness, coverage, warnings, and a typed allowed-section error for one corrected retry. Discover current entity sections via sr_runtime_health with components:['mcp'], catalog:{kind:'entity',key:'<entity_type>'}. Use only canonical sections for the entity type: activity_event: overview, actor, operation, result, correlation, freshness, coverage; application: overview, status, booking, event, schedule, freshness, coverage; artifact: overview, current_version, google_drive, versions, links, audience, retention, provenance, download, available_actions, freshness, coverage; attachment: overview, availability, message, task, download, freshness, coverage; booking: overview, status, booking, event, schedule, payout, freshness, coverage; coordination_event: overview, actor, operation, target, result, correlation, freshness, coverage; event: overview, status, event, schedule, location, booking, bookings, applications, lineup, ticketing, prices, capacity, sales_summary, configuration, provider, provider_details, provider_links, finance_summary, finance, invoices, operations, status_evidence, canonical_timeline, history, freshness, coverage; message: overview, sender, recipient, task, attachments, state, available_actions, freshness, coverage; meeting: overview, participants, summary, auto_created_tasks, auto_updated_tasks, manually_linked_tasks, review_proposals, signals, links, report, transcript, provenance, freshness, coverage; operation_run: status, result, receipt, post_check, freshness, coverage; organization: overview, status, product_access, plugin_access, freshness, coverage; payout_case: overview, status, amount, event, freshness, coverage, status_evidence, canonical_timeline, history; person: detail, overview, role, status, current_tasks, important_projects, memberships, relationships, activity, agent_runs, receipts, notifications, provenance, freshness, coverage; plugin_user: overview, role, status, coordination_capabilities, freshness, coverage; show: overview, status, schedule, events, location, ticketing, sales_summary, product_access, provider_links, freshness, coverage; signal: overview, status, source, links, freshness, coverage; slot: overview, status, availability, booking, event, location, schedule, payout, freshness, coverage; subscription: overview, status, amount, freshness, coverage; task: detail, overview, project, requester, assignee, thread, provenance, linked_context, context_links, references, message, attachments, comments, updates, agent_runs, receipts, notifications, timeline, state, available_actions, freshness, coverage; task_proposal: overview, requester, assignee, provenance, decision, resulting_task, available_actions, freshness, coverage; ticket_class: overview, status, identity, prices, capacity, ticketing, provider, freshness, coverage. Operation-run sections: status, receipt, post_check; result, freshness, and coverage are also available. Common event/show sections: overview, schedule, location, ticketing, prices; consult the entity-specific list above for the rest. For payout_case prefer overview, status, amount, event, freshness, and coverage; status_evidence, canonical_timeline, and history remain compatibility sections. The event, bookings, finance, and operations event sections remain explicit compatibility sections. Unsupported sections return entity_section_not_supported with the exact allowed list; do not probe aliases.

sr_entity_query.title: Query Standup Republic entities
sr_entity_query.description: Run one bounded, versioned query profile for lists, aggregates, timelines, or reports. Read the selected profile's availability, role, scope, filter, select, grouping, and sort contract before calling; do not try guessed profiles or filter probes. Omit select when the profile publishes an answer-ready default. Use at most one supported sort, pass canonical scope_ref when available, and reuse next_cursor unchanged for the same query. Additional safe per-item Gets are usually unnecessary after a complete projection. blocked/unsupported profiles are discoverable but not callable; typed errors state the exact retry contract. Discover current profiles via sr_runtime_health with components:['mcp'], catalog:{kind:'overview'}; fetch exact filters and projection with catalog:{kind:'query',key:'<profile>'}.

sr_runtime_health.title: Check Standup Republic runtime health
sr_runtime_health.description: Read sanitized status, freshness, last-success evidence, and bounded metrics for selected components: auth, identity, coordination, attachments, database, main_app, mcp, agent_runtime, meeting_sync, payout_pipeline, and ticketing_sync. window is a bounded lookback. detail_level=summary is available to Employee and Admin; diagnostic is Admin-only and fails closed with allowed_detail_level=summary for Employee callers. Optional catalog reads the live server registry: components:['mcp'] with catalog:{kind:'overview'} lists capabilities; kind action/query/entity and key returns exact current contracts. Use this before declaring a capability unavailable from installed plugin files. Catalog metadata is not target authorization. This tool does not expose raw logs, provider payloads, file names, or Production rows.

sr_action_prepare.title: Prepare a Standup Republic action
sr_action_prepare.description: Validate and freeze one registry-backed Product or internal Coordination action without mutating state. Before declaring an operation unavailable, discover the live registry via sr_runtime_health with components:['mcp'], catalog:{kind:'overview'}, then catalog:{kind:'action',key:'<operation>'} for exact payload and reference requirements. Choose operation by availability, required role, target type, confirmation_policy, use_when/not_for, required references, dependencies, and exact payload guide. A request to move, reschedule, or rebook an existing comedian between slots is booking.move with both source and destination slot refs; resolve ambiguous names through the occupied source slot and never substitute booking.remove. For Event text, the words Memo, Notiz, or Beschreibung alone are ambiguous: ask whether the user means organizer-only internal note, public customer description, or public Event title before calling Prepare. Never infer visibility from a legacy UI label. Omit legacy domain; the server derives it from operation and rejects mismatches. Invalid payloads return machine-readable missing_fields, unexpected_fields, and expected_shapes for one corrected retry. A successful Prepare returns a 48-hour manifest, opaque prepare_token, confirmation_policy, and execution_ready. For not_required operations call Execute immediately without showing a preview or asking again; required operations must wait for explicit user confirmation.

sr_action_execute.title: Execute a prepared Standup Republic action
sr_action_execute.description: Execute exactly one previously prepared active action after authorization and state revalidation. If Prepare returned confirmation_policy=required, call only after explicit user confirmation; if it returned not_required, call immediately without another user turn. Pass the exact opaque prepare_token plus a caller-generated stable 16-128 character idempotency_key using letters, digits, dot, underscore, tilde, or hyphen; never use manifest_ref as the idempotency key, and likewise never use prepare_token, receipt_ref, or another sr: reference. Reuse the same key only for a retry of the same execution. A succeeded action proves only the operation's canonical internal contract: requested proves durable Main App outbox acceptance only; claim provider acceptance only from post_check.external_effects state provider_accepted, sending only from sent, delivery only from delivered, and reading only from read, each with canonical evidence. Explicitly state not_requested_by_policy, requested, queued, processing, provider_unknown, failed, or unknown; never paraphrase them as sent, delivered, received, published, shared, or successfully dispatched. For an unknown transport outcome, reconcile operation_run_ref with sr_entity_get sections status, receipt, and post_check; never blind-retry with a new key. Gated, blocked, local-only, and unsupported operations remain non-executable in Production.
